credential_key.description: Equals the file name (identifiers.adoc, credential_key; PM-CRED-1).

url.description: Operator-owned; its origin is the only origin the secret is sent to (PM-CRED-5).

auth_type.description: github_app only for credential_key github; basic only for git-https and non-provider keys.

token_kind.description: token only, github, gitlab, and forgejo keys only; determined from the provider by set and verify (ci.whoami), never entered. Every kind is accepted (cli-and-security.adoc, Agent Credentials of the Native Variant).

client_id.description: github_app only: the App's client id, JWT issuer.

private_key.description: github_app only: PKCS#1 PEM (BEGIN RSA PRIVATE KEY, the form GitHub issues) or PKCS#8 PEM (BEGIN PRIVATE KEY); the stored secret from which installation tokens are derived (never persisted themselves, PM-CRED-5).

refresh_token.description: github_app only: the App's user refresh token from the device flow; the stored secret of the user access token (never persisted itself, PM-CRED-5); replaced by its rotated successor in every refresh (cli-and-security.adoc, User Access Token).

installation_id.description: github_app only, optional: else discovered per repository owner through GET /repos/{owner}/{repo}/installation.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry of a token (for github_app: of the refresh_token, rewritten with it in every refresh): taken from the provider by set and verify where reported, else entered by the operator at set; absent means no known expiry, shown in the runtime status, never refused. The status reports expiring within the credential expiry warning window (timeouts.adoc#credential-expiring-window).

verified_at.description: Last successful verification of the credential.
